title: An arrow can loop from a box back to itself
body:
An arrow cannot run from a box back to the same box. At `c846b14`, `arrow { from a; to a; route curve; }` draws nothing, and acre gives no error.

A profile HMM has states that loop to themselves. In the cloud-search figure these are N, C and each insert state I. The figure draws the HMM around two profile positions and has no way to draw those loops. It says "N, C and each I also loop to themselves" in a note instead. State machines and automata draw self-loops all the time.

## Proposal

- An arrow whose `from` and `to` name the same thing draws a loop out of one side and back into it. `side` picks the side, and the default is `top`.
- An arrow that draws nothing is an error.
close_reason: Landed in 84eb63e on dev. A line or arrow from a thing to itself loops out of the side `side` names, top by default, and follows the thing as it moves. A `side` on a non-loop and a line whose ends meet are errors. The syntax note is on acre-4518a5.
